All Regional P.F. Commissioners
In-charge of the ROs/SROs

Subject: Delegation of Powers to APFCs and Accounts Officers (AO) for speedy
Settlement of Claims and Updation of members’ accounts.
Sir,

In order to mitigate the pressure of workload on APFCs and Accounts Officers
(AQ) due to shortage in the either cadre, the CBT, EPF in its 198" meeting held on
22.02.2012 has empowered the Officers-in-Charge of the ROs/SROs, depending on the
requirement, to allot the work of settlement of claims to Assistant P.F. Commissioner and
Updation of Members’ Accounts to the Accounts Officer (AO), apart from their regular
duties.

Accordingly, Officers-in-charge of ROs/SROs may allot the work among AOs and
APFCs on need basis.

Yours faithfully,
